title: Looks nice!
text: Looks nice!. This is a lightweight soap dispenser. I was expecting it to be more heavy duty sadly it is not.  The material is definitely not stainless steel but resembles it well. It matches my stainless kitchen sink. Overall: Soap is easy to dispense, easy to use, does not leak however pricey for what it is.

product_metadata.title: FRUD Soap Dispenser Stainless Steel Bottle,Countertop Anti-Rust and Pump Hand Lotion Liquid Dispenser for Kitchen and Bathroom,Brushed Nickel (23.67 oz / 700ml)
